Nayanthara Joins Rajinikanth's Upcoming Film 'Dharman'

Actor Nayanthara has officially joined the cast of superstar Rajinikanth's upcoming film, *Dharman*. The casting update marks a notable onscreen reunion between the two prominent actors, who have previously shared the screen in *Chandramukhi*, *Kuselan*, *Darbar*, and *Annaatthe*.

Production and Crew Details

*Dharman* is directed by Ashwath Marimuthu, known for *Oh My Kadavule* and *Dragon*, taking over the director's chair following changes in the production trajectory. The film is backed by Raaj Kamal Films International, headed by veteran actor-producer Kamal Haasan.

The project boasts a robust technical and supporting lineup. Alongside Rajinikanth and Nayanthara, the movie features Simran, Raashi Khanna, and Yogi Babu in lead roles. The film's music will be composed by Anirudh Ravichander, with cinematography handled by Niketh Bommi and editing by Pradeep E Ragav.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

As details regarding the production emerge, audiences and film enthusiasts can review the official announcement channels for updates.

  • What is confirmed: Nayanthara's casting in *Dharman* was officially announced by production banner Raaj Kamal Films International. The core creative team, including director Ashwath Marimuthu, music composer Anirudh Ravichander, and co-stars Simran, Raashi Khanna, and Yogi Babu, has also been confirmed.
  • What remains unknown: Specific details regarding Nayanthara's character arc, plot specifics, and the official theatrical release date have not yet been disclosed by the makers.
  • How to verify: Readers can check the original announcement and follow ongoing updates directly through the official X (formerly Twitter) handle of Raaj Kamal Films International (@RKFI) or read the full report published by *The Hindu* at The Hindu Entertainment Section.
